_comment: Copy to sources.json (git-ignored) and edit. '~' is expanded; relative paths resolve against this file's folder. enabled=false skips a source. tool: claude-code / antigravity (log folders), opencode / codex (the SQLite file or the folder that directly holds it; opened read-only) are ready; t3 is a placeholder until redacted samples exist. Optional billing: "subscription" (default; counted in the plan ROI) or "api" (pay-as-you-go API key; shown as Direct API spend, kept out of the ROI).
